source.note: Barbarian.glb from the pack's GitHub mirror, pinned to commit 672074b (LICENSE.txt: CC0, Kay Lousberg). The rig carries every alternative prop; kept 1H_Axe + Barbarian_Round_Shield (the same one-handed weapon-and-shield set as knight-kaykit), dropped 1H_Axe_Offhand, 2H_Axe and Mug. 27 of 76 clips kept (1H weapon-and-shield set; ranged, 2H, dual-wield, spellcast, unarmed and lie-down clips dropped). Height 1.6 m: KayKit characters are chibi (head about a third of the body), so a 1.8 m adult scale makes the head read huge next to realistic props; 1.6 m keeps the head near a real head size, and matches the knight from the same pack.
